 Match Preview
 Africa Cup of Nations Qualification - Game Week 4 17 Nov 2026 - 13:00 Liberia host Cabo Verde in the Africa Cup of Nations Qualification, with both sides looking to make their mark in Group K.
 Liberia come into this fixture sitting bottom of the group after a difficult run of results. Coach Mohammed Erradi's side have struggled for consistency, and their recent qualifying campaign has produced little to encourage their supporters.
 Cabo Verde arrive in stronger shape. Humberto Bettencourt's squad carry momentum from a 4-2 win over Liberia in the reverse fixture earlier this month, and they have recent World Cup experience to draw on after competing in the 2026 tournament.
 The Blue Sharks reached the World Cup group stage, drawing 0-0 with Saudi Arabia before falling 3-2 to Argentina. That exposure to elite competition gives Cabo Verde a psychological edge heading into this qualifier.
 Liberia's need for points is urgent. Sitting fourth in the group, they have little margin for error if they want to keep qualification hopes alive.
